summary: Verified TypeScript strict-mode DO build fix in paymentLinkController.ts and regression-tested the affected donation/crowdfunding v2 endpoints. `yarn tsc --noEmit -p .` from /app/backend now completes with 0 errors in ~8.7s (exact command DO's build pipeline runs before yarn build). GET /api/pay/getPaymentLinks (auth=hostbay@moxx.co) returns 200 with 6 links including donation link_id=77 whose `donation` sub-object contains all 6 new v2 keys (story_md, gallery[3], ends_at, category='creative', organizer_thanks, beneficiary object) — confirms the local PaymentLinkData interface additions did not regress the mapping logic. Phase 3.3 regression endpoints intact: /api/pay/campaign/77/tiers returns 5 seeded tiers, /api/pay/campaign/77/updates returns 3 seeded updates.
critical_code_review_comments: paymentLinkController.ts is 2376 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into feature modules (create/list/donation/crowdfunding) for maintainability. Not blocking, but the local PaymentLinkData interface duplication (defined inline inside getPaymentLinks) is a symptom — Sequelize model attributes are the source of truth and should be exported/shared instead of re-declared per handler.

The cast `(donationFields.goal_amount as number | null) ?? null` on line 760 works but is a type-assertion band-aid. Prefer a proper Zod/Yup validator or narrowing (`typeof x === 'number' ? x : null`) so strict-mode types match runtime shape without `as`.

Pre-push tsc gate mentioned in test_credentials.md (Husky v9 + scripts/preflight-tsc.sh) is the right long-term fix — this class of bug (local dev uses ts-node --transpile-only, DO uses full tsc) should never reach the remote again.

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded donation campaign link_id=77 (5 tiers + 3 updates from Phase 3.3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The DigitalOcean 'deployment stuck' report was NOT an app runtime bug — the ACTIVE deploy was already on the latest commit. Prior push builds errored at `yarn build` (tsc strict mode) because ts-node --transpile-only in local dev skips type checks. Main agent fixed by: (1) adding 6 donation_* fields to the local PaymentLinkData interface at lines 972-978 of paymentLinkController.ts, (2) casting goal_amount to (number | null) on line 760. Regression suite confirms zero runtime-shape drift. If next push still errors on DO, first run `cd /app/backend && yarn tsc --noEmit -p .` locally — that is the exact preflight and it currently returns 0.
rca of the issue: Root cause: TypeScript strict-mode compilation errors surfaced only in DigitalOcean's `yarn build` step (which invokes full tsc) but not in local dev (which uses ts-node --transpile-only, skipping type checks). The `donation` object literal in getPaymentLinks response spread referenced 6 new columns (donation_story_md, donation_gallery, donation_ends_at, donation_category, donation_organizer_thanks, donation_beneficiary) that were on the Sequelize model but absent from the inline PaymentLinkData interface — tsc flagged 7 property-not-found errors plus 1 signature mismatch on sendCrowdfundingCampaignCreatedEmail (Decimal-typed goal_amount vs. `number | null` param). Reproduction: `cd /app/backend && yarn tsc --noEmit -p .` on pre-fix HEAD → 8 errors. Mitigation applied: interface augmented + explicit cast added. Verification: (a) tsc = 0 errors, (b) live endpoint returns correct donation.* subobject shape, (c) unrelated tiers/updates endpoints unchanged. Preventive: Husky pre-commit + GitHub Actions preflight already in place per test_credentials.md session 43 note.
